name: Smart Cabling Solutions
old_description: Singlemode, Multimode, Armored, Outside Plant, Fusion splicing
about:
Smart Cabling Solutions, Inc. is based in Olathe, Kansas, and was founded in 2001 by Ron Wagner. The company began with a focus on personalized, hands‑on service for commercial network infrastructure. In the same year, Brian Koester, an RCDD‑certified Vice President of Operations, and Jeff Cox, Vice President of Business Development, joined the leadership team, helping the firm build long‑term relationships with customers, vendors, and manufacturers.

The company provides a full range of low‑voltage installation services: structured copper cabling (Cat 5e, Cat 6, Cat 6A, coaxial), fiber‑optic cable installation (singlemode, multimode, armored, outside‑plant) with fusion splicing using factory‑polished pigtails, data‑center build‑outs (cabinets, racks, wire management, ladder and cable tray), wireless access‑point and network‑equipment deployment, and removal of abandoned cable. Technicians use Fluke Versiv DSX‑8000 and Link IQ testers, calibrated annually, and multiple Fujikura and Fitel fusion splicers. Projects span facilities from 50,000 sq ft to over 1 million sq ft.

Smart Cabling serves warehousing and distribution, manufacturing and industrial, healthcare, corporate offices, education, and data‑center clients. Its customers include business owners, general contractors, IT professionals, and facility managers who need standards‑compliant infrastructure that supports current technology and future growth.

The firm differentiates itself through its Cat 6A expertise (thousands of Cat 6A cables and jacks installed), a fusion‑splicing process standardized since 2007, manufacturer‑backed warranties as a Commscope (Systimax/Uniprise 20‑year) and Leviton (lifetime) business partner, and a quality‑assurance program that includes documented testing, clean installations, and adherence to ANSI/TIA/EIA standards.
